watch.summary: The creator hilariously narrates a humanoid robot attempting to check out cheerleader robots, only to immediately miss its step and fall off a platform.

beats.what: Creator introduces the cheerleader robots performing a routine.
Creator narrates another robot climbing up as if trying to check them out.
The robot steps right off the edge and falls down.
Creator bursts into hysterical laughter and disappears off-screen.
Creator gives absurd commentary about the robot acting like a man going after ladies.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: And dude just misses his step and then...
watch.why: The creator's funny anthropomorphic narration turns a simple robot stumble into a hilarious story of a guy getting distracted by girls and instantly falling flat on his face. The physical comedy of the fall paired with the streamer's uncontrollable laughter creates a great, universal joke.
